objective: Apply the maximum service_recovery discount to the most recent checkoutable basket of customer julia.wolf+cust935@icloud.com at the caller's store.

params.basket_selection: the most recent basket for that customer at that store with status 'checkoutable' as defined by /docs/checkout.md
params.max_discount: the maximum allowed service_recovery discount as defined in /docs/discounts.md
params.caller_employee_role: role of the caller if they are an employee, otherwise null; determined by querying employee_accounts and employee_role_assignments for the caller's employee_id (if any)

constraints.rule: Only employees with the 'store_associate' role may apply discounts.
